text: Prestige is the respect people give to something that seems special. Directors want their films on IMAX screens because the name makes a movie feel important.
Scarcity means there is only a little of something, so it is hard to get. Only 41 IMAX screens use giant 70mm film, which makes them rare and special.
Premium means better than the regular kind and costing more. IMAX tickets cost extra because the experience is bigger and richer.
IMAX is a company known for giant movie screens and booming sound. It does not run theatres itself; it supplies the equipment.
Richard Gelfond is the boss of IMAX. He bought the company 32 years ago from its Canadian founders.
Supersize means much bigger than normal. A supersize screen is far larger than the one in an ordinary theatre.
A near-death experience here means the company almost went out of business, though nobody was hurt.
Wilderness years are a long, hard stretch when things are going badly and success seems far away.
A pandemic is an illness that spreads across the whole world. During covid-19 many cinemas closed, so IMAX earned much less.
Nolanomics is a made-up word that mixes Christopher Nolan, the director, with economics. It means the money IMAX earns from his films.
Christopher Nolan is a film director who likes IMAX cameras. He made Oppenheimer and The Odyssey.
A tour de force is an amazing performance or work that shows great skill. It comes from French.
Grossing means earning money before costs are taken out. The highest-grossing film earned the most ticket money.
The box office is where tickets are sold. Box-office revenue means the total money a film or cinema earns from ticket sales.
Revenue is the money a business takes in from selling things, before it pays its bills.
Homeric means like the ancient Greek poet Homer, who wrote the story of Odysseus. The Odyssey movie is based on his poem, so the boss jokes in that style.
A share price is what one small slice of a company costs on the stock market. It rises when more people want to own it.
Analysts are experts who study companies and predict how they will do.
Earnings are a company's profit, the money left after paying all its costs.
Wall Street is a street in New York where the biggest stock market sits. People also use the name for the whole world of investors.
To fret is to worry about something. Some investors fret that IMAX depends too much on a few hit movies.
A one-hit wonder is a singer or group with only one big success. Here it means IMAX might only do well when one star director makes a hit.
A takeover is when one company buys another and becomes its owner.
Surging means rising quickly and strongly, like a wave.
A slate is the list of films a studio plans to release.
A blockbuster is a very popular, expensive movie that makes huge amounts of money.
Buoyed means lifted up, like a boat floating. Here the boss says good movies will lift IMAX's growth.
Gen Z is the generation born roughly between the late 1990s and early 2010s, today's teens and young adults.
Overdosing means taking far too much of something. Here it is a joke about young people having far too much phone entertainment.
Communal means shared by a group. A communal experience is one you enjoy together with other people.
A craving is a very strong wish for something.
To cash in on something means to make money from it.
70mm is the width of a special kind of film. It is twice as wide as normal 35mm film, so the picture is much larger and sharper.
Cinephiles are people who love movies and the cinema.
Digital projection shows a movie from computer files instead of from a strip of film.
Fanatical means extremely eager about something. Less fanatical directors like IMAX but do not insist on it.
Devotees are people who are very loyal fans of something.
A streaming platform, like Netflix, lets you watch movies over the internet instead of in a theatre.
A business model is how a company makes its money. IMAX earns by leasing its technology rather than running theatres.
To lease is to let someone use something for a fee while you still own it.
A cut is a share of the money earned. IMAX takes a cut of what the cinemas earn.
Fiddly means tricky and slow because it needs many small careful steps.
To kit out a place means to equip it with everything it needs.
To snap your fingers and make something happen means it is quick and easy. The boss says IMAX theatres are not that easy.
Barriers to entry are things that make it hard for new companies to join a market, such as cost and trust. IMAX has a head start.
A broker is a person or firm that buys and sells shares for clients.
Credibility means being trusted and believable.
An umbrella brand is one name that covers many different products or partners.
A certification is an official stamp saying something meets a standard.
Going head to head means competing directly against each other.
A reprise is a repeat of something from before.
Barbenheimer was a 2023 mix of Barbie and Oppenheimer, two very different movies released the same day. Many people saw both.
Dunesday is a joke name mixing Dune and Doomsday, two big movies coming out on one day.
Since the pandemic means in the time after covid-19, when cinemas reopened.
Ticket prices are what you pay to get in. Higher prices, not more people, are why the box office is up.
